questions.question: Born on this day in 1989, singer Vanessa White originally gained widespread fame as a member of which British girl group?
questions.explanation: Vanessa White rose to stardom beginning in 2008 as one of the members of the British pop band The Saturdays.
questions.context:
On this day in 1989: Vanessa White, English singer, former member of The Saturdays
Vanessa White (English singer (born 1989)): Vanessa Karen White is an English singer who rose to fame in 2008 as a singer in the girl group The Saturdays. White began her career as a theatre actress at an early age, appearing in several West End productions.

questions.question: In which year was Sir Ian McKellen knighted by Queen Elizabeth II?
questions.explanation: Sir Ian McKellen received his knighthood from Queen Elizabeth II in 1991.
questions.context: Ian McKellen (English actor (born 1939)): Sir Ian Murray McKellen is an English actor. Widely considered one of Britain's greatest actors, he is noted for his versatile roles on stage and screen, in genres ranging from Shakespearean dramas and modern theatre to popular fantasy and science fiction. He is regarded as a British cultural icon and was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 1991.

questions.question: Which English actor, famous for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard, was married to American singer-songwriter Sunny Ozell?
questions.explanation: Sunny Ozell, Lady Stewart was married to stage and screen actor Sir Patrick Stewart until he passed away in 2026.
questions.context: Sunny Ozell (American singer-songwriter (born 1978)): Sunny Ozell, Lady Stewart is an American singer and songwriter who resides in Los Angeles, California. She was married to the English actor Sir Patrick Stewart until his death in 2026.

questions.question: What is required from a user in order to register an account on Meta's messaging platform WhatsApp?
questions.explanation: To register and use WhatsApp Messenger, users must provide a cellular mobile phone number.
questions.context: WhatsApp (Messaging and VoIP service owned by Meta): WhatsApp Messenger, commonly known simply as WhatsApp, is an American social media, instant messaging (IM), and Voice over IP (VoIP) service accessible via desktop and mobile app. Owned by Meta Platforms, the service allows users to send text messages, voice messages, and video messages, make voice and video calls, and share images, documents, user locations, and other content. The service requires a cellular mobile telephone number to register. WhatsApp was launched in May 2009.

questions.question: Benjamin Netanyahu first became Prime Minister of Israel in which decade?
questions.explanation: Benjamin Netanyahu began his first term as prime minister of Israel in 1996.
questions.context: Benjamin Netanyahu (Prime Minister of Israel (1996–1999; 2009–2021; 2022–present)): Benjamin "Bibi" Netanyahu is an Israeli politician and diplomat who has served as prime minister of Israel since 2022. Having previously held office from 1996 to 1999 and from 2009 to 2021, Netanyahu is Israel's longest-serving prime minister.
